resolve_providers: resolve all autoresearch platform providers including builtin and extension providers discovered via entry points
find_provider: find a specific autoresearch platform provider by name or auto-select the highest priority available provider
discover_extension_providers: discover autoresearch platform extension providers from environment variables and Python entry points
validate_common_config: validate an autoresearch configuration dict checking agent kind, source directory, and pipeline script paths
create_agent_for_config: create a coding agent instance from an autoresearch configuration dict with the specified agent kind
